Crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysore multiple times over the years. A crocodile was spotted at the bank of Kukkarahalli Lake recently, triggering panic among morning walkers, according to an article from January 28, 2026. [1] Another article from December 1, 2024, reported a huge crocodile sighted near the fishermen's shed close to Hunsur Main Road. [2] The article also mentions that this is not the first time a crocodile has been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake and that many walkers have previously reported sightings. [2] In September 2023, morning walkers were worried after spotting a crocodile in the lake, and the Forest Department had previously rescued crocodiles from the lake. [3] A giant crocodile was also spotted on the Kukkarahalli Lake bund in March 2010, reaffirming the presence of crocodiles in the lake. [4]
